reply: Thank you for explaining that you went through several lenders while buying a vehicle and that a lender you told you were not using is now involved in your loan. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of any agreement in your name and the date it was signed, and keep the documents from your chosen lender. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you applied for a $3,000.00 cash loan, a hard inquiry was made, and the only offer was to take over your car loan at a much higher balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the terms of the offer and the reason no cash-only option was offered, and keep the website screenshots. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan servicing was transferred and you have not received a welcome notice, an account number or a way to pay online. We understand your concern about making payments on time. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please keep the transfer email, and send a written request for your account details and payment options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two payments you made were returned, that you then received late payment calls, and that your bank says the payments should have gone through. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank's records of both payments, and ask in writing for the reason each payment was returned and a review of any late fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you updated your payment card after the old one was cancelled for fraud, but you are now told you owe $210.00 and the old card is still on file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the chat records, and ask in writing for your payment history and for the old card to be removed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were offered other products to get the loan, that amounts due to you were not refunded at payoff, and that you receive frequent calls. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreement, the daily interest terms and a payoff statement, and keep a log of the calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a payday loan was taken out in your name after your identity was stolen, and that you have been told the loan is valid. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your identity theft report and your information request, and check your credit reports for other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was repossessed under a $2,500.00 title loan without notice, and that you can no longer see your loan documents online. We understand the effect this has on your health and income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of your loan documents, any repossession notices, and what is needed to recover the car. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after you left your job with the lender, the remaining balance of your flex loan was taken from your final paycheck without notice. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreement, the payment authorization on file and a payment history, and keep your pay records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a check you later learned was a loan, without having applied or seen the terms, and that it now affects your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of the loan disclosures and any application on file, and dispute inaccurate items with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you chose a 12-month plan for your furniture loan, but your account was set up for 24 months. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the signed agreement showing the term, and keep any notes of your conversation with the representative. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are paying a 119% interest rate on a $1,400.00 car repair loan and still owe over $1,000.00 after a year. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreement and a payment history showing interest and principal, and keep your records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are sorry for the loss of your husband. Thank you for explaining that payments continued after you sent the death certificate, and that your refund requests were refused, leaving your account overdrawn. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the payments team. Please keep the death certificate submission and your call notes, and ask in writing for automatic payments to stop. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your paychecks are being garnished for a loan that included add-on products that were not explained, and that the local branch has closed. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your original paperwork, and ask in writing for an itemized balance and contact details for the account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being contacted about a loan you never took out, and that you were asked to send an affidavit with your personal information. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please confirm the company is genuine before sending information, and ask in writing for details of the debt. Keep all texts and emails you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that funds from your withdrawn disputes were returned, but you were told they were never received, and you paid $180.00 again to avoid collections. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep records of the withdrawn disputes and the payment you made, and ask in writing for a full account history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a routing number error at the start of your loan has caused failed payments and extra phone payment fees every month. We understand your frustration after ten months. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send your correct bank details in writing, and ask for confirmation that autopay is fixed and for a review of the fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your balance did not go down after a year of payments, and that you were told your loan restarted because some payments were a few days late. We understand how difficult this is on a fixed income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan terms and a full payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received $9,000.00, your statement shows a $19,000.00 loan, and you will repay $33,000.00. We understand why this does not add up for you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreement, a breakdown of the amount financed and fees, and a payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believed your $900.00 loan had a 34.59% interest rate, and only later learned the rate is far higher. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the signed agreement and its disclosures, and keep your payoff statement. The APR shows the yearly cost of the loan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collection on your credit report is unfamiliar to you and that you believe it is not yours. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the item with the credit reporting companies that show it, explain why you believe it is wrong, and include any supporting documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing the difficult time you went through and explaining that your request for verification of the debt did not produce the documents you asked for. We understand how stressful this has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep your request and any response, and dispute specific inaccurate items with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have not been able to make an extra payment because the payment button is unavailable, and that your balance has grown even though you have not missed a payment. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep screenshots of the problem and your emails, and ask in writing for another way to make extra payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the $900.00 loan for your pet's emergency care had terms that differ from what was advertised, including about prepayment. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the advertising you saw and the contract you signed, and ask in writing for an explanation of the terms. You can check whether your loan has a prepayment penalty. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you ordered a $1,900.00 program by mistake, that the merchant will not communicate with you, and that you were reported late. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute explaining the mistaken order, and keep any messages to the merchant. You can also dispute inaccurate reporting with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan balance does not reflect your payments, and that you were told this is because of late payments. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for a payment history showing how each payment was applied to interest, fees and principal, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your personal and account information was shared with a stranger, and that you are now being contacted about court papers. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team, including the collection activity. Please write down what you know about the disclosure, and respond to any court papers by the deadline. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that unauthorized transactions were made on your unemployment benefits card, and that the card was not cancelled promptly or replaced. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Please keep your report and the dates of each call, and ask in writing for a replacement card and the result of your claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $350.00 charge you did not authorize was made on your account and that your claim has not been resolved. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your claim details and any messages, and ask in writing for the result of the investigation and the reasons for it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $200.00 gift card was declined, that you were told it was compromised, and that the replacement card never arrived. We understand your disappointment with a wedding gift. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Please keep the card, the receipt if available and notes of each call, and ask in writing for tracking or a new replacement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
